generate_2dseg_query: run the script to generate 2D segmentation query points for all instances in a scene from ADT data
load_scene_metadata: load scene metadata and instance information from transforms.json and instances.json files in the data folder
filter_instances_by_area: filter segmentation instances by area threshold to skip small masks and background ApartmentEnv instances
select_query_points: select random query points from eroded instance masks for 2D segmentation queries
save_query_json: save the generated 2D segmentation query points as a JSON file in the scene data folder
